chapters.name: Introduction to Microeconomics
topics: Central problems of an economy — What, How, For whom to produce
Centrally planned economy vs Market economy vs Mixed economy
chapters.note: A - Microeconomics | Estimated: 4-6 | Difficulty: Easy | Scoring: Very high — pure theory, memorization

chapters.name: Theory of Consumer Behaviour
topics: Utility — meaning, cardinal vs ordinal approach
Total Utility (TU) and Marginal Utility (MU) — relationship
Budget line, budget set, slope of budget line (-Px/Py)
Consumer's equilibrium — cardinal and ordinal approach
Shift in budget line (price change, income change)
chapters.note: A - Microeconomics | Estimated: 8-10 | Difficulty: Medium | Scoring: High — diagrams + formulas dono clear hone chahiye

chapters.name: Production and Costs
topics: Production function — short run and long run
Total Product (TP), Average Product (AP), Marginal Product (MP)
Returns to scale — increasing, constant, decreasing
Cost concepts — Fixed Cost, Variable Cost, Total Cost
Average Cost (AC), Marginal Cost (MC), AFC, AVC
chapters.note: A - Microeconomics | Estimated: 8-10 | Difficulty: Medium to Hard | Scoring: Medium — numericals scoring hain agar formula yaad hai

chapters.name: Theory of Demand and Supply
topics: Law of demand — statement, assumptions, diagram
Shift in demand curve (normal, inferior goods)
Price elasticity of demand — meaning, degrees, measurement
Exceptions to law of demand (Giffen goods, prestige goods)
Supply — meaning, determinants, law of supply
Firm's supply curve in short run and long run
chapters.note: A - Microeconomics | Estimated: 10-12 | Difficulty: Medium | Scoring: Very high — diagrams + numericals guaranteed marks

chapters.name: Forms of Market and Price Determination
topics: Market equilibrium — meaning, excess demand, excess supply
Effect of shifts in demand/supply on equilibrium
chapters.note: A - Microeconomics | Estimated: 6-8 | Difficulty: Easy to Medium | Scoring: High — features/definitions easy

chapters.name: National Income and Related Aggregates
topics: Circular flow of income in simple economy
GDP, GNP, NDP, NNP — at market price and factor cost
Methods of calculating national income — Product/Value-added method, Income method, Expenditure method
Factors of production and their remunerations (Land-Rent, Labour-Wages, Capital-Interest, Entrepreneurship-Profit)
chapters.note: B - Macroeconomics | Estimated: 6-8 | Difficulty: Medium | Scoring: High — mostly theory + formulas

chapters.name: Money and Banking
topics: Demand for money (transaction, precautionary, speculative motives)
Supply of money — M1, M2, M3, M4
Commercial banks — functions, credit creation / money creation
RBI as lender of last resort
Monetary policy tools — CRR, SLR, Repo rate, Reverse repo, OMO
chapters.note: B - Macroeconomics | Estimated: 6-8 | Difficulty: Easy to Medium | Scoring: Very high — definitions + functions lists guaranteed marks

chapters.name: Determination of Income and Employment
topics: Aggregate demand (AD) and its components (C + I + G + NX)
Average Propensity to Consume (APC), Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC)
Average Propensity to Save (APS), Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS)
Classical vs Keynesian theory of employment
Excess demand and deficient demand — effects, correction measures
chapters.note: B - Macroeconomics | Estimated: 6-8 | Difficulty: Medium to Hard | Scoring: Medium — multiplier numericals + Keynes theory important

chapters.name: Government Budget and the Economy
topics: Direct taxes (Income tax, Corporate tax) vs Indirect taxes (GST, Excise)
GST — meaning, advantages over old tax system
Balanced budget, surplus budget, deficit budget
Revenue deficit = Revenue expenditure - Revenue receipts
Fiscal deficit = Total expenditure - Total receipts (excluding borrowings)
Primary deficit = Fiscal deficit - Interest payments
Public goods — meaning, why government must provide them (non-excludable, non-rival)
Financial year in India (1 April to 31 March)
chapters.note: B - Macroeconomics | Estimated: 5-7 | Difficulty: Easy to Medium | Scoring: Very high — definitions + distinctions easy

chapters.name: Balance of Payments and Foreign Exchange
topics: Balance of Trade (BOT) — exports minus imports of goods
Balance of Payments (BOP) — current account + capital account
Current account items (merchandise trade, services, transfers)
Capital account items (FDI, FII, loans, investments)
Balance of trade vs Balance of payments — distinction
Floating / Flexible exchange rate — merits, demerits
Open economy autonomous expenditure multiplier (why smaller than closed)

tips: Section Q1-Q5 mein SAB 32 questions attempt karo — no negative marking, guaranteed marks
Internal choice mein Q6-23 ke dono options dekh lo, jo aata hai wo attempt karo
Diagrams labeled + neat — axes par P, Q; curves par D, S, MR, MC clearly likho
Numerical mein units mandatory — Rs., kg., % jo bhi applicable ho
Distinction questions: 2-column table banao (left A, right B), 3-4 points har side
Features/Functions questions: point-wise numbering use karo, 1-2 line each
Hindi medium wale students: technical terms English mein bracket mein likh sakte ho — MPSE accepts dono
Formulas margin mein likho before starting numerical (MPC = ΔC/ΔY, k = 1/MPS, etc.)
[Checklist] 5 key formulas: Ed = (ΔQ/ΔP)(P/Q) | MPC = ΔC/ΔY | k = 1/(1-MPC) | AR = TR/Q | Profit = TR - TC
[Checklist] 5 key diagrams: Demand curve | Indifference curve | U-shaped cost curves | Market equilibrium | Circular flow
[Checklist] 5 key distinctions: Micro vs Macro | Revenue vs Capital expenditure | Direct vs Indirect tax | Fixed vs Floating forex | BOT vs BOP
[Checklist] 5 key definitions to memorize verbatim: Opportunity cost | Effective demand | Fiscal deficit | Primary deficit | Foreign exchange rate
[Checklist] 5 key functions lists: Money (4 primary + 4 secondary) | RBI (7) | Commercial banks (primary + secondary) | Budget (4 objectives) | Perfect competition (6 features)
[Checklist] 3 numerical types: Price elasticity | Multiplier from MPC | Production function Q=f(L,K)
[Checklist] Read at least 3 PYQ papers full — 2024, 2025, 2026 — to spot pattern

time_allocation.note: 32 questions × ~1 min each. MCQ/Fill/T-F pehle karo — fastest. Match pair thoda time lega. One-sentence last.
10 questions × 4 min each. 30-word limit — crisp definitions + 1 example.
4 questions × 10 min each. 75-word limit — 3-4 points, ek diagram if possible.
4 questions × 12 min each. 120-word limit — numerical solve karo step-by-step, ya diagram + explanation + 2-3 points.
Numerical answers check karo, diagram labels verify karo, missed questions attempt karo.
